name: retake
description: Claude skills for authoring scenarios, themes and components with Retake, and the Retake MCP server on one workspace.

node.title: Node.js 22 or later
node.description: Absolute path of the node binary that runs the server (retake mcp --print-config prints one).

cli.title: Retake entry point
cli.description: Absolute path of packages/cli/dist/bin.js in the Retake repository (built with pnpm build).

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Absolute path of the workspace folder the server works on (its retake.yaml or projects/ folder).

home.title: Retake home (optional)
home.description: Absolute path of the Retake home (signed-in profiles, approval key). Empty: ~/.retake.
